scope: 28 functional acceptance requirements. Routes are source references to verify, NOT proof that the page consumes them. No blocked case is counted as passed by a mock or documentation test.
commonPrerequisites: Isolated PostgreSQL and running API verified
Two synthetic institutions/authorized accounts actually seeded
Phase 48/49 risk gates satisfied for the proposed use
No real minor or production data
commonMethod: Perform the described action from its page/API
Inspect server confirmation and authorized database state
Repeat with another user/institution or invalid state
Retain redacted evidence and defect IDs

cases.expected: Valid credentials yield verified /auth/me and own dashboard; invalid credentials never authenticate
Session revoked on server; no previous private view or late refresh reopens it
Refresh/revocation/expiration/password change enforce server identity across reload
Horizontal/vertical escalation and foreign-institution resource access rejected
Only authorized roles/routes after direct URL/reload/profile switch; demo never substitutes private data
Only courses allowed by real enrollment/publication, not all institution drafts
Correct authorized published version and resources load without executing untrusted content
Attempt starts, answers save, submit and formative correction are authoritative on server
Close/reopen and timeout/retry do not lose answers or duplicate confirmed effects
Assigned version protected, valid attempt/submission/review/publication lifecycle
Only published authorized results visible, hidden keys/drafts remain private
Same confirmed completion denominator/version in dashboard, course and report
Rule-confirmed personal achievements remain unique on retry/concurrent completion
Teacher publishes, recipient submits once, teacher publishes feedback, correct student reads it
Authorized tasks/events civil dates/timezone correct, no duplicated aggregation
Only current valid teacher assignments/classroom enrollments visible
Assigned teacher reviews authorized evidence; unpublished feedback remains private
Human authorized valuation/rectification/history; no automatic percentage conversion or Sync/AI write
Institution-scoped operations, protected fields cannot elevate roles or cross tenants
Teacher draft, authorized review/publication and student view agree on immutable version
Confirmed sources/denominators, correct period/enrollment, small-group privacy and safe export
Authorized confirmed sources, insufficient-data state, human-controlled recommendations
Available provider really generates safely; unavailable is explicit; dictionary/reference not misrepresented
Authorized idempotent push/pull, receipts/cursors survive restart and lost response
Valid package, close/reopen/reconnect preserves provisional answers, quota/conflicts and A-B-A isolation
Exercise all critical modules with A/B and modified IDs, never leak individual or aggregate records

cases.requirement: Errores fiables en todos los flujos
cases.expected: 401/403/409/422/429/5xx/network/timeout preserve work and never report false confirmation
Paths/Node commands verified; another authorized operator can reproduce backend/infra using safe documented steps
